Idaho Cleaning Services

Professional construction and commercial cleaning throughout Eastern Idaho, Treasure Valley, and southeastern Idaho. Serving Idaho Falls, Pocatello, Boise, Twin Falls, and surrounding communities.

Eastern Idaho Market Overview

Imperial Cleaning Inc. is headquartered in Idaho Falls, positioned at the heart of Eastern Idaho's diverse industrial landscape.

Nuclear & Research

Idaho National Laboratory (INL) represents one of the nation's premier nuclear research facilities.

Healthcare & Medical

Eastern Idaho Regional Medical Center, Portneuf Medical Center, and numerous healthcare facilities.

Food Processing & Agriculture

Magic Valley food processing (Chobani, Clif Bar) and Eastern Idaho's agricultural sector.
